name: AMD Ryzen 7 5700X 8 Cores 16 Threads Processor Up To 4.6GHz
shortDescription: AMD Ryzen 7 5700X 8-Core 16-Thread Unlocked Desktop Processor (Socket AM4 / 3.4GHz Base Clock / Up to 4.6GHz Max Boost / 32MB L3 Cache / 65W TDP / Zen 3 Architecture / TSMC 7nm FinFET / PCIe 4.0 Support / DDR4 Up to 3200
descriptionHtml:
AMD Ryzen 7 5700X 8-Core 16-Thread Unlocked Desktop Processor (Socket AM4 / 3.4GHz Base Clock / Up to 4.6GHz Max Boost / 32MB L3 Cache / 65W TDP / Zen 3 Architecture / TSMC 7nm FinFET / PCIe 4.0 Support / DDR4 Up to 3200MHz / 1-Year Store Warranty)

Unleash high-performance desktop computing with the AMD Ryzen 7 5700X processor, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by a 1-Year store warranty. Built on the award-winning Zen 3 architecture using TSMC 7nm FinFET technology, this processor packs 8 physical cores and 16 processing threads to effortlessly handle modern AAA gaming, heavy multi-tasking, high-resolution video editing, and content creation. Operating at an efficient 65W TDP, it features a 3.4GHz base clock, up to 4.6GHz max boost clock, 32MB of unified L3 cache, PCIe 4.0 support, and compatibility with standard Socket AM4 motherboards.
